speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Left Lower Lobe). Despite normal initial labs, your clinical presentation of purulent sputum, fever, and pleuritic pain is classic for bacterial pneumonia; the previous CTs may have been misinterpreted or taken before consolidation developed. Please start broad-spectrum antibiotics immediately and repeat a chest X-ray in 48 hours to confirm resolution.
